m1_length.description: Channel length of M1 (PFET pull-up). DIV2 cell, stage-1 latch PFET pull-up (clocked, gated by clk).

m1_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M1 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m2_length.description: Channel length of M2 (NFET pull-down / latch). DIV2 cell, stage-1 latch NFET pull-down (clocked, gated by clk).

m2_width.description: Channel width of M2 (NFET pull-down / latch).

m2_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M2 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m3_length.description: Channel length of M3 (PFET pull-up). DIV2 cell, stage-1 latch second PFET pull-up (data-path, gated by the stage-1 internal node).

m3_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M3 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m4_length.description: Channel length of M4 (NFET pull-down / latch). DIV2 cell, stage-1 latch second NFET pull-down (data-path, gated by the stage-1 internal node).

m4_width.description: Channel width of M4 (NFET pull-down / latch).

m4_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M4 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m5_length.description: Channel length of M5 (NFET pull-down / latch). DIV2 cell, stage-1 extra clocked NFET pull-down implementing the modulus-control 'OR' path onto the stage-1 output node -- together with ME0 (en_*), this is what lets the external 'sw' feedback (routed through MW0, sw_*) force an extra half-cycle when enabled, turning the cell's nominal divide-by-2 into divide-by-3.

m5_width.description: Channel width of M5 (NFET pull-down / latch).

m5_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M5 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m6_length.description: Channel length of M6 (PFET pull-up). DIV2 cell, stage-2 latch PFET pull-up (plain TSPC latch closing the 2/3-cell's feedback loop).

m6_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M6 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m7_length.description: Channel length of M7 (NFET pull-down / latch). DIV2 cell, stage-2 latch NFET pull-down.

m8_length.description: Channel length of M8 (NFET pull-down / latch). DIV2 cell, stage-2 extra clocked NFET pull-down (clk-gated, completes the stage-2 TSPC latch's dynamic evaluate/hold behavior).

m8_width.description: Channel width of M8 (NFET pull-down / latch).

m8_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M8 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m9_length.description: Channel length of M9 (PFET pull-up). DIV3 cell, stage-1 latch PFET pull-up -- second cascaded 2/3-cell, same role as m1 one stage down.

m9_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M9 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m11_length.description: Channel length of M11 (NFET pull-down / latch). DIV3 cell, stage-1 extra clocked NFET pull-down (same modulus-control role as m5, one stage down).

m11_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M11 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m12_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M12 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m15_length.description: Channel length of M15 (PFET pull-up). Output buffer inverter PFET pull-up -- drives the block's 'out' pin (and the testbench's Cload), sized larger than the core latch devices for adequate output drive.

m15_fingers.description: Finger count (nf) of M15 -- layout/parasitic split of the total width across parallel gate fingers, does not change drive strength.

m16_length.description: Channel length of M16 (NFET pull-down / latch). Output buffer inverter NFET pull-down -- see m15.

en_length.description: Channel length of ME0/ME1, the two per-cell enable/modulus-control NFETs (etspc_d2d3.sch's 'en' pin gates both instances via this one shared parameter group). Together with M5/M11, these implement each 2/3-cell's swallow path.

sw_length.description: Channel length of MW0, the modulus-control switch NFET gated by the block's own 'sw' input pin -- couples the DIV2 cell's internal stage-1 node to the DIV3 cell's own internal feedback node when enabled, coupling the two cascaded 2/3-cells' modulus control together so a single external 'sw' bit shifts the WHOLE block's overall division ratio by one (see tb/divider/tb_divider_funct.py for how the actual ratio for each 'sw' level is measured rather than assumed -- the sw=low/high -> ratio mapping has not been confirmed against a real simulation yet).
